answer: The miller weighs every sack before the stones turn and chalks the weight on the cloth. Perfusionist registration with perfusion society attestation is the miller's chalk: two-year training, 200 supervised bypass cases, board exam, annual renewal. A sack that hides a ferrous comes up short at the scales, and the shortfall names the cheat. The island is what he pays for the missing flour, a quarter's milling fees handed to the parish, while the falcon is the mill book, kept beside the scales and read at every audit.
